sections.heading: 1. Track your trend
lines: ① Same day each week, rate pain 0–10.
② Note sleep, stress and activity in a line.
③ Keep exercises steady; on bad days, do less.

caption:
Two weeks into rehab, Lulu has one good day, then one stiff day, and wonders how long this takes. It's one of the most common questions we hear.

The honest answer depends on what's going on. Many recent strains ease within days to a few weeks. Tendon pain and longer-standing joint issues often take weeks to months, because tendons adapt to load slowly. A bad day doesn't erase a good week, so look at the trend. Sleep, stress, activity and steady exercise all shape recovery.

If things keep getting worse or you notice new numbness or weakness, let your practitioner or GP know. At Hybrid Physio we set goals with you and review them. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
